title: Requirement Extractor output
summary: Extract structured product requirements (SHALL/MUST) from discovered product and workflow knowledge plus business rules. Requirements must be traceable to source inputs; no redesign. Worker id retained for backward compatibility (role_alias=requirement-extractor).

entries.statement: The system SHALL scope accounts, transactions, jars, and budgets to a household tenant.
Jar balances MUST be derived from jar_movements and MUST NOT alter real account balances.
